phases.name: Foundations
phases.summary: Progressive unlock. New blocks arrive in stages, only when the active ones hold.

phases.name: Build
phases.summary: Full template week. Dynamo, then Navisworks.

phases.name: PFE
phases.summary: PFE takes Monday and Sunday evenings and the Saturday afternoon. Learning drops to one 45 min maintenance session. Training stays.

stages.summary: Sleep window. Breakfast and lunchbox with protein. Muay Thai x3. PFE blocks. Evening plan and 3 line journal. Weekly review. Football whenever friends play.
Strength A and B. Water target. Mobility after Muay Thai. No phone for the first 20 minutes. Water bottle on the desk. Stand every hour.
Learn blocks (Dynamo starts). AI lab. Lunch tutorials.
Thursday sketch. Saturday architecture session. Reading 20 min before bed. Screens off at 23:00.
Easy run on Wednesday. Optional modules, only one at a time.
